en: Colorized vintage view of a low, red‑roofed brick hospital complex with verandas and decorative trim. A white picket fence encloses a small garden with a palm tree and central lamp post in the foreground. Several nurses or staff in white uniforms and a few other figures stand near the building. The caption in red at the top left reads "Hospital – Mildura." The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, typical of early color postcards.
